page.content:
Shaolin champion who won the first tournament for Earthrealm.

How Liu Kang connects

  • Location: Earthrealm — Liu Kang is Earthrealm's chosen Shaolin champion.
  • Event: Mortal Kombat tournament — Liu Kang won the first arcade-era Mortal Kombat tournament.
  • Work: Mortal Kombat (1992) — Mortal Kombat (1992) made Liu Kang the Shaolin who wins the island tournament.
  • Work: Mortal Kombat 1 — Mortal Kombat 1 casts Fire God Liu Kang as keeper of the new era.
  • Character: Goro — Liu Kang ended Goro's centuries-long tournament streak.
  • Location: Wu Shi Academy — Liu Kang trained at the Wu Shi Academy.

What is Liu Kang?

Liu Kang is Earthrealm's chosen Shaolin: the Mortal Kombat (1992) winner who later became Fire God and, in Mortal Kombat 1, the keeper of a new timeline.

Key threads lead to Earthrealm, Mortal Kombat tournament, Mortal Kombat (1992), Mortal Kombat 1, Goro and Wu Shi Academy.
